name: Exp_VolatilityQuality
summary: This EA trades based on the Volatility Quality indicator, which identifies momentum shifts by analyzing price volatility patterns. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from bearish to bullish and sell positions when it transitions from bullish to bearish, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Volatility Quality指标进行交易，通过分析价格波动率模式来识别动量转换。当指标从看跌转为看涨时开多仓，从看涨转为看跌时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Volatility Quality指标作为核心信号源，该指标通过平滑算法（支持多种平滑方法如SMA、EMA、LWMA、JJMA等）对价格波动率进行计算，以识别市场动量的方向性转变。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1从值0变为值1时（Col[1]==0且Col[0]==1），产生买入信号；当指标缓冲区1从值1变为值0时（Col[1]==1且Col[0]==0），产生卖出信号。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），同时支持基于信号的反向平仓（BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的多种资金管理模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、损失后自由保证金、损失后余额或固定手数模式。策略在H4时间框架上默认运行，使用SignalBar参数控制信号偏移（默认为1，即前一根K线），并通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只处理一次信号，避免重复交易。总体而言，这是一个基于波动率质量判断的动量跟踪系统，通过波动率的变化来捕捉趋势的起始和结束。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Volatility Quality indicator as its core signal source, which calculates price volatility through various smoothing algorithms (supporting SMA, EMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) to identify directional shifts in market momentum. Entry conditions are: when indicator buffer 1 transitions from value 0 to value 1 (Col[1]==0 and Col[0]==1), a buy signal is generated; when it transitions from value 1 to value 0 (Col[1]==1 and Col[0]==0), a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), while also supporting signal-based position closing controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing leverages multiple money management modes from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot sizing. The strategy operates by default on the H4 timeframe, uses the SignalBar parameter to control signal offset (default 1, meaning the previous bar), and employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure each bar is processed only once to prevent duplicate trades. Overall, this is a momentum-tracking system based on volatility quality assessment, capturing trend initiation and termination through changes in volatility characteristics.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/固定手数等）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（信号反向平多仓）
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position closing (close long on reverse signal)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（信号反向平空仓）
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position closing (close short on reverse signal)

parameters.name: Price
parameters.description: 应用价格类型（收盘价/中间价）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已收盘K线）

pros: 使用IsNewBar机制确保每根K线仅处理一次信号，避免同根K线内重复交易
支持多种平滑算法和灵活的参数配置，适应不同市场环境
提供买入和卖出的开仓与平仓独立开关，可灵活控制交易方向
信号基于已收盘K线（SignalBar=1），减少信号 repaint 风险
多模式资金管理，从固定手数到动态保证金计算均有覆盖
pros_en: Uses IsNewBar mechanism to ensure each bar is processed only once, preventing duplicate trades within the same bar
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms and flexible parameter configuration for adapting to different market conditions
Provides independent toggle switches for buy/sell opening and closing, allowing flexible directional control
Signals based on closed bars (SignalBar=1), reducing signal repaint risk
Multi-mode money management covering fixed lot to dynamic margin calculation
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动率动态调整，在低波动市场可能过大
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能导致不合理的入场
指标信号来源为iCustom自定义指标，依赖外部文件，可移植性和透明度较差
无移动止损或保本机制，盈利头寸可能大幅回撤后才止盈或止损
无最大持仓数量限制或总风险敞口控制，可能在连续信号时过度建仓
cons_en: Fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility, potentially too wide in low-volatility environments
Lacks spread filtering, which may lead to unreasonable entries in high-spread conditions
Indicator signal relies on iCustom external custom indicator, reducing portability and transparency
No trailing stop or breakeven mechanism, profitable positions may retrace significantly before hitting TP or SL
No maximum position count or total risk exposure control, potentially over-allocating on consecutive signals
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，使风险控制适应市场波动率变化
添加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提升入场质量和整体风险控制
增加移动止损（Trailing Stop）和保本止损功能，保护浮动利润
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit calculation to adapt risk control to market volatility changes
Add spread filtering and maximum position count limits to improve entry quality and overall risk management
Implement trailing stop and breakeven functionality to protect floating profits

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致不利入场
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，极端行情下可能不足或过度
无最大持仓限制，连续信号可能导致过度集中风险敞口
risk_points_en: Lacks spread filter, widened spreads during high volatility periods may cause unfavorable entries
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility, may be insufficient or excessive during extreme market conditions
No maximum position limit, consecutive signals may lead to over-concentrated risk exposure
